title: navigator-validate is dead enforcement: its only state writer (pageindex-navigator) was disabled/unregistered, so the task-mismatch branch can never fire; the remaining haiku branch duplicates no-haiku-enforcer and emits its warning on the wrong channel

evidence.quote: The per-prompt `pageindex-navigator` hook was disabled 2026-06-01 (Item 6 — telemetry showed 0/16 query-hits at 1.8–15.8s/prompt).

observe_how: Grep confirms only two importers of shared/navigator-state.ts: navigator-validate (reader) and pageindex-navigator (the sole saveState writer for this state) — and pageindex-navigator appears in NEITHER repo nor active settings.json. With no writer, loadState() always returns the default detectedTaskType 'UNKNOWN', and isAgentValidForTask() returns true for UNKNOWN (navigator-state.ts line 226), so the mismatch warning is unreachable. The haiku check duplicates no-haiku-enforcer, which runs on the same Agent matcher and hard-DENIES — making the soft warning moot. Meanwhile the hook still runs on every Agent spawn and, when it does emit, uses permissionDecision 'allow' (same auto-approve channel problem as D2a-01). Telemetry context: 30/36 agents never in agent-recall suggests this validation layer provides no observed value. Delete the registration, or repoint the reader at a live task-type source.
